text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time after the team's training progress falls into a slump…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They get embroiled in a messy incident.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh! Traaainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I thought you should know but we, uh, got roped into an unofficial match against Team Zenith!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! But you see…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whose drink is this? No one's written their name on it…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'd better move it into the shade. It'll get all warm if it's left out in the sun like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah! Oh no, I spilled it all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It just so happens that the drink belonged to Little Cocon, who shows up at exactly the wrong time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I know we're not on friendly terms, but I didn't expect you to pull something like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, members of both teams gather to see what the commotion is about.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, you're all mistaken! Rice isn't that kinda person! There's no way she did it on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Are you trying to tell me she spilled the entire drink "on accident"? Yeah, right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the argument gets more heated, the other members of Team Zenith attempt to intervene.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, this calls for an off-the-books match! Nothing like a little competition to settle things!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Buuut it'd be boring to just have a regular old race. So, how about this—whoever loses is banned from the track… forever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Interesting proposal. I'm in. Since you're all so weak, I'll make this even easier for you.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: If you manage to win a single race against us, then we'll consider you the overall victors.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! You won't be so smug for long!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And that seems to be the long and short of what happened!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurry to the track to see the contest already in full swing.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The whole team is excitedly cheering on Haru Urara from the stands.
choice_data_list: You guys already started the contest?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm super-duper sorry, but we couldn't let them get away with bad-mouthin' us!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But they're pretty strong, so I'm not sure if Urara is gonna be able to…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: S-so fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race on the dirt track is only half done, but it's clear who the winner is.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She's too strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara passes the finish line long after her opponent.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: They're so fast, but they're also just so darn unflappable…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's enough for warming up.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though their teammate just won, Team Zenith barely spares her a glance and silently continues their warm-ups.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a stark contrast with our team's members, who are cheering their teammates on as hard as they can.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Man… They're all just focused on their own progress and work, just like members of a professional team.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I need to get my head in the game too! By the way, how are we doing in the races?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: W-we've lost every one?! Then… the only chances we have left are my medium-distance race and Rice's long-distance race?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I was awful out there… It might've been because I couldn't focus during training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We can't continue on like this! I'm going to warm up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, in the race that follows…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Raaah! This is for the team! I won't lose, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Guts! Glory! And gumptiooon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: How is she getting so far ahead?! I'm doing my best over here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry… I really wanted to win, but I couldn't… At this rate, we'll be banned from the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: D-don't ya worry about it! As long as Rice wins in the long-distance race, we'll be golden!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Show 'em your stuff, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We're counting on you, Rice! Please win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine, Rice! You've got this in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! I'll w-win this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Rice Shower looks shaky and pale as she leaves for the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a bit worried, so I run after her, only to find her standing frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's my fault that we got into this situation… I must win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You can do this, Rice… You can win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm just a moment too late. Rice Shower dashes off with a pallid face before I can call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, my fears turn out to be justified.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Huff… I c-can't lose! The entire team's future is at stake!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: All together now… YOU GOT THIS, RICE SHOWER!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hah, you scaredy-cat. Running for your team's sake isn't getting you anywhere, is it?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: You'd be better off if you just quit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower loses by a margin of five lengths.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! It's all my fault! We'll never be able to use the field again because of me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's not your fault, Rice. None of us were able to win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It'll be tough not being able to use the track, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team is shaken, but frankly, I don't think their opponents should have been permitted to set such outrageous stakes in the first place.
choice_data_list: I'll have a word with Ms. Kashimoto about this bet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're visibly relieved when I assure the team that we'll nullify the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew! Everything will be all right, then!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm a bit put out by the fact that none of us won, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, we're just getting started, Fukukitaru! We just hafta work harder together and train even more from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, the team manage to get back into their groove, with everyone being relaxed and friendly toward each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Ms. Kashimoto thankfully agrees that the bet should be nullified, so nobody is banned from using the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But ever since that day, Rice Shower seems more quiet and gloomy than usual during team practice…
